_meta.description: 200 body of GET /api/vehicles/{vehicleId}/invites (rest-api.md §7.5.2), verbatim from the spec example. Note the envelope key is `invites`, NOT `items`: this surface is deliberately unpaginated (no cursor, no hasMore) and the distinct key keeps an SDK pagination helper from mistaking it for a page. Revoked rows are never serialized, so a consumer never filters. `code`/`expiresAt` appear only on the pending row; `acceptedAt` only on the accepted one. MYR-368 — `shareUrl` (contracts 0.22.0, the complete SIGNED join link) is present EXACTLY WHERE `code` IS, so it is on the pending row and absent from the accepted one. That pairing is the point of this fixture: a client must never expect to re-read either value for a grant that has been redeemed.
